title: Purchase candidate (chapter 5)
description: What the host purchase flow hands the guard. Values the host cannot supply must be null, never invented; every null lands in the decision's missing_fields.

idempotency_key.description: Set by the host flow. A reappearing request_id with a matching key is a retry; without one it is treated as a possible double spend.

retry_of.description: Explicit retry marker, if the host sets one.

purpose.description: Normalised to the purchase's purpose. Do not paste raw conversation history.

request_params_hash.description: Hash of the normalised request parameters. Must not include credentials or signatures.

amount.description: Decimal string. Never a binary float.

prior_acquisitions.description: Snapshot as of observation. Frozen then, so an asynchronous evaluation cannot see this purchase among its own priors.

summary.description: Short description of what was acquired. No raw or confidential content.
